name: Mad World
source:
By chance, in a bar at night, you meet a strange man who claims to be a god. The power he gives you opens the door to a world filled with violence and injustice, but also hope and goodwill. With new enemies, new friends, and a new life, each choice will define your mental state and the relationships of those around you forever.

The underworld of Magical Relics call.​
translation:
一次偶然的机会，晚上在酒吧里，你遇到了一个自称是神的奇怪男人。他赋予你的力量打开了通往一个充满暴力和不公正，但也充满希望和善意的世界的大门。新的敌人、新的朋友、新的生活，每一个选择都将永远决定你的精神状态和周围人的关系。

魔法遗迹的地下世界召唤。​
